title: Heat-Driven Desiccant Comfort and Water Platform for Humid Climates (Land and Marine): CaCl2 Liquid-Desiccant and Aluminum-Fumarate MOF Coated-Exchanger Tracks
notes: Defensive publication. No patents sought or held. Hardware: CERN-OHL-P v2; documentation: CC-BY-4.0; scripts: MIT. CPC classification (verified 2026.08): F24F 3/14, F24F 3/1411, F24F 3/1417, F24F 3/1429, F24F 3/147, F24F 12/00, F24F 5/0035, B01D 53/14, B01D 53/04, B01D 53/26, B01D 53/261, B01D 53/28, B01D 53/62, B01D 53/1475, C02F 1/04, C02F 2103/08, B63J 1/00, B63J 2/02, B63J 2/04. Not F24F 3/1423 (rotary wheel) — the solid track is a coated stationary exchanger.
